topic: Defining dwell time metric for reporting
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the precise definition of 'dwell time' within new release documentation. Initially, there was confusion over whether dwell time should be measured 'per visit' or 'per person'. It was determined that 'per session' is the most accurate metric because calculating it per unique person is not feasible, and treating a single visit as a cluster metric would result in an overly long duration.

Consequently, the definition of dwell time will be updated to reflect 'per session'.
decisions: Dwell time metric for reporting will be defined as 'per session'.
